method.capture_alignment: One most recent common capture per reel; every predictor shares the same capture date and matching recorded view count.
method.validation: Outer leave-one-reel-out; ridge strength selected by inner leave-one-reel-out separately in each fold. Each candidate feature set is evaluated separately; final model choice remains exploratory.
method.action_rates: Actions divided by views times 100, which reuse the outcome in the denominator; models using these are descriptive and can have mathematical coupling.
method.baseline: Geometric mean views; account baseline is a separate geometric mean per account.
limits: Only 19 or fewer aligned reels and four accounts, with two accounts represented by only two reels.
Retrospective metrics on completed reels do not establish early-post forecasting performance.
Account-based predictions apply to the represented accounts, not automatically to a new account.
View counts, rate cards and retention have different measurement conventions; some source counts are rounded.
